2609.40235.title: Distribution Matching Distillation for Continuous Diffusion Language Models
2609.40235.paper_summary: Continuous diffusion language models generate all tokens in parallel, yet high-quality generation can still require hundreds of network evaluations (NFEs). We study how distributional distillation can reduce this cost by exploiting the student's probabilistic token outputs. Our unified formulation connects the student's output parameterization to the resulting gradient estimators and yields two methods with the same student architecture and reverse-KL matching objective: Simplex-DMD uses continuous token relaxations and pathwise gradients, while Reinforce-DMD uses categorical sampling and REINFORCE with a learned density ratio. We develop both methods for multi-step generation and investigate the training and sampling choices associated with each parameterization. On OpenWebText, for sequences of 1,024 tokens, Simplex-DMD achieves a generative perplexity of 45.6 at a unigram entropy of 5.44 nats in just 4 NFEs, a 49% reduction relative to the strongest evaluated diffusion baseline at matched entropy and sampling budget. Reinforce-DMD improves the frontier at larger budgets, reaching a generative perplexity of 14.9 at an entropy of 5.00 nats with 256 NFEs, a 20% reduction under the same comparison protocol.
2609.40235.paper_summary_zh: 持續擴散語言模型以平行方式生成所有標記，但高品質生成仍然可能需要數百次網絡評估（NFEs）。我們研究如何通過利用學生的概率標記輸出來減少這一成本。 我們的統一公式將學生的輸出參數化與結果梯度估計器聯繫起來，並產生兩種具有相同學生架構和反向KL匹配目標的方法：Simplex-DMD 使用連續標記放鬆和路徑梯度，而 Reinforce-DMD 則使用類別抽樣和帶有學習密度比的 REINFORCE。我們為多步生成開發了這兩種方法，並研究與每種參數化相關的訓練和抽樣選擇。在 OpenWebText 上，對於 1,024 個標記的序列，Simplex-DMD 在僅 4 次 NFEs 時達到 45.6 的生成困惑度，單元熵為 5.44 nats，相較於在匹配熵和抽樣預算下評估的最強擴散基線減少了 49%。Reinforce-DMD 在更大的預算下改善了前沿，以 256 次 NFEs 達到 14.9 的生成困惑度，熵為 5.00 nats，在相同比較協議下減少了 20%。
